questions.question: Solve x² − 5x + 6 = 0.
questions.explanation: Factor to get (x − 2)(x − 3) = 0. A product is zero when at least one factor is zero, so x = 2 or x = 3.

questions.question: Solve x² = 16.
questions.explanation: Both 4 × 4 and (−4) × (−4) equal 16. Therefore, x = 4 or x = −4. Remember both the positive and negative roots.
